sources.title: Jarno Lintusaari, Michael U. Gutmann, Ritabrata Dutta, Samuel Kaski, and Jukka Corander, Fundamentals and Recent Developments in Approximate Bayesian Computation
sources.locator: Complete 47-page peer-reviewed version retrieved. Inspected PDF pp. 1–6, 10–23, and 46–47; also checked the summary-target discussion on p. 26. The local proofs do not import the review's unqualified small-tolerance convergence wording.
sources.reading_verification: Downloaded the complete PDF to /tmp/bcs62-b27-lintusaari and extracted all 47 pages with PyMuPDF. Read the simulator-based model and Bayesian setup, exact rejection algorithm, tolerance-conditioned ABC distribution, summary-statistic distortions, acceptance-rate and finite-computation discussion, threshold bias trade-off, and the rejection/MCMC/SMC algorithm descriptions. The source's finite-simulation examples distinguish target error from Monte Carlo error. The local density-limit theorem adds and proves its own pointwise-version, positive-normalizer, and integrable-envelope hypotheses.

contents.name: Simulator-based prior model and exact rejection
contents.locator: PDF pp. 4–6 and 10–14; Algorithms 1–2 on pp. 11 and 16
contents.support: Supplies the simulator-based Bayesian context. The local definition constructs the prior-predictive summary law from the measurable kernel.

contents.name: Accepted law under a positive tolerance event
contents.support: The source identifies the accepted parameter law as the posterior conditioned on the tolerance event. The local proof supplies the geometric first-success calculation and almost-sure termination.

contents.name: Summary-statistic information loss and persistent target distortion
contents.locator: PDF pp. 15–20, especially equations (5)–(7) and the comparison of T1 and T2
contents.support: Supports separating the summary posterior from the full-data posterior. The local theorem proves recovery under the common-kernel sufficiency condition and the stated density factorization.

contents.name: Acceptance probability, finite simulation error, and tolerance bias
contents.support: Supports the distinction between a correct accepted-draw target, low acceptance, finite-run Monte Carlo error, and positive-tolerance target bias. No universal acceptance rate is claimed.

contents.name: Summary density at zero tolerance
contents.reason: The review states an informal small-threshold summary-posterior limit without the chosen density-version, positive finite evidence, continuity, and integrable-envelope hypotheses required here. The local theorem proves a precise total-variation limit instead.

contents.name: Failure without an integrable local envelope
contents.reason: The review does not provide the moving-spike counterexample or a theorem dropping the envelope. That countable construction and its total-variation separation are proved locally.

contents.name: MCMC-ABC and sequential Monte Carlo ABC
contents.reason: This pair authors prior-proposal indicator ABC rejection only; the later MCMC and SMC algorithms are assigned elsewhere.
